runtime: node>=22 (host role; not a wasm component)
serves: POST / JSON-RPC 2.0 for browser network profiles (eth_chainId, eth_blockNumber, eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_call, eth_estimateGas, eth_getCode, eth_getBalance, eth_getTransactionCount, eth_getStorageAt, eth_getLogs, eth_getTransactionReceipt, eth_getTransactionByHash, eth_sendRawTransaction, eth_getProof, eth_getBlockByHash, eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas, eth_getBlockReceipts; eth_sendRawTransaction only with an operator-stated propagation route), GET /health; reads from the operator's own node, the verifier's methods (eth_chainId, eth_blockNumber, eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_call, eth_getCode, eth_getStorageAt, eth_getBalance) from the local verifier when configured, never a third-party RPC
secrets: none (no key, wallet or signing method; the node and verifier are loopback endpoints)
cold: the operator's own synced Base node on this machine (loopback)
optionally this host's local verifier (loopback) for the methods it proves
